questions: Trace change-only discovery, toolchain preflights, service dependencies and freshness fingerprints.
Test false unhealthy signals, deadlocks and environment versus semantic classification.
decision: Maintain a content-fingerprinted, least-privilege resource map with explicit readiness, health and progress roles; reconcile only relevant inventory inputs and fail unknown observations conservatively.
code_observations: service_map supplies discovery/freshness and validation binding; resource_watch uses toolchain/resource checks and evidence packets.
The preserved map contains historical validations unrelated to active tasks. A map entry existing does not prove its command still targets a present file or supported version.

symbols.name: ## 3. Run mapped validations under the watcher

implementation_steps: Audit every active validation reference against actual files/commands and the discovery snapshot. Replace stale version literals and removed-path checks with contract-based assertions.
Fingerprint only relevant discovery inputs and update the map when those inputs change. Do not repeatedly scan all historical logs or unrelated source trees.
Distinguish starting, healthy, unhealthy and unknown states; use startup grace and bounded repeated samples before declaring environment failure.
Correlate each validation with only its assigned resources, toolchains and logs. Missing privileges or metrics must be reported as unknown, not success or an automatic semantic escalation.
Keep the reusable map outside plan cleanup; avoid injecting all resource inventory into every implementation prompt.
Separate startup readiness, runtime health and task progress in resource observations.
Reject stale content fingerprints and unsafe or unbounded probes; unknown observations never mean healthy.
Measure probe count and duration per validation and reuse only generation-valid scoped inventory.
proposed_acceptance_tests: Removing a referenced test file or changing toolchain input makes the map stale/actionable.
A service inside startup grace is not misclassified as unhealthy.
An unresponsive health probe ends at its bounded timeout and does not stall the watcher.
A semantic failing test with healthy dependencies differs from a dependency outage.
Unrelated resources are not probed or read for a focused validation.
An open port with an unready service blocks dependent validation without escalating the model.
A same-size build configuration change invalidates the map.
Probe timeout or permission denial is explicit unknown/environment evidence.
A map probe cannot silently run a service repair command.

cost_model: Measure inventory and probe CPU/I/O separately from test runtime. Reuse validated metadata, not stale health results; no model call is needed for ordinary map reconciliation.
unverified: Container-local probes do not certify the user's actual databases, JVM deadlocks, networks or Windows services.
No real project services were started in this research round. Fixture readiness results do not establish production dependency health.
runtime_experiments: No authenticated provider invocation, live quota/cost benchmark, independent model review, or Windows runtime test was performed in this research revision.
previous_decision: Retain the reusable project resource map with change-scoped freshness and bounded preflights; make missing or stale evidence visible.
revision_delta: The map is no longer treated as just a list of services. The revision separates discovery, readiness, ongoing health and actual work progress, and adds probe-cost and unsafe-command tests.
decision_analysis: A running process or open port does not prove the dependency is ready for validation. Map the toolchain and resource checks needed by each validation id, and establish readiness before running the command. Keep an explicit empty resource list for tests that require no external service; never infer a dependency from a generic project file alone.

Fingerprint relevant build, dependency, test and environment declarations by content. A same-size edit or timestamp-preserving replacement must invalidate the inventory. Avoid scanning the entire repository or rereading all service logs for every focused check. Use per-validation selection and cache only within a verified input generation.

Probes must be bounded, read-only and independent of the model being tested. A health check should not repair or restart a service as a side effect. Sanitize output before recording; unknown, permission-denied or timed-out checks must not be interpreted as healthy. Host/process ownership matters when the same service name exists elsewhere.

Monitoring cost is itself a budget. Polling too often can load a dependency and create the incident being diagnosed. Configure cadence per resource and stop observers when the owned validation terminates. Keep readiness failures separate from productive task stalls and capability failures.

ownership: This implementation owns its declared write scope and acceptance tests. Its following review checks the actual changed code; prepared research is not acceptance evidence.
baseline_anchor_check: All listed file hashes matched the preserved 0.11.0 source in this revision. This is integrity checking, not a second full code audit.
applicability_rule: Refresh only evidence contradicted by the installed CLI, selected account/billing plan or changed code contract. Unknown required capability blocks that candidate; it does not justify widening permissions.
